example_prompt: Fetch a saved Flutterwave customer by id to charge a returning buyer.

id.description: Path parameter. ID of the customer.

line1.description: The first line of the Customer's address.

line2.description: The second line of the Customer's address.

country_code.description: The dialling country code e.g. 234 for NG.

number.description: Unformatted 7-10-digit phone number without the country code.

message.description: Present on 401/403/409 bodies; the 400 body has none.

type.description: Error category. Generic: REQUEST_NOT_VALID, UNAUTHORIZED, FORBIDDEN, RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND, RESOURCE_CONFLICT, UNPROCESSABLE, INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR; or a domain type (see code).

code.description: String. Generic 10400/10401/10403/10404/10409/10422/10500, or a domain code documented for this endpoint: none specific (the general table's 10404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND).

gotchas: Auth (OAuth2 client credentials): POST grant_type=client_credentials, client_id and client_secret as application/x-www-form-urlencoded to https://idp.flutterwave.com/realms/flutterwave/protocol/openid-connect/token (same token URL for sandbox and production), then send `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`. Docs (Authentication): "Each token is valid for **10 minutes**"; "We recommend refreshing the token at least one minute before it expires." Cache the token. FLUTTERWAVE_CLIENT_CREDENTIALS = base64(client_id:client_secret) is an afrotools convention, decoded locally; Flutterwave never receives it. Sandbox base URL: https://developersandbox-api.flutterwave.com ("We archive your test data after 30 days.")

Headers: X-Trace-Id is optional on this GET (the headers guide lists it under 'Optional API Headers'; "It must be a string using only alphanumeric ASCII characters.", 12-255 characters). The API reference documents no X-Idempotency-Key for this endpoint.

Docs (Card Payments): "To fetch an existing customer's details, use the [retrieve customer](/v4.0/reference/customers_get) endpoint  with the customer's `id`. This is useful when initiating charges for returning users."
The API reference lists only 200/400/401/403 for this endpoint; an unknown id falls under the general error table (10404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND). The exact HTTP status is not documented.

Errors: {"status":"failed","error":{"type","code","message","validation_errors"}}; error.code is a string and 400s carry validation_errors[{field_name,message}]. Besides the generic codes (10400 REQUEST_NOT_VALID, 10401, 10403 FORBIDDEN, 10404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND, 10409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT, 10422 UNPROCESSABLE, 10500) the error table documents these for this endpoint: none specific (the general table's 10404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND). Branch on error.type / error.code, not on the HTTP status alone. Docs (Errors): "The current limit is 500 API requests per minute." A 429 can come back as a non-JSON page ("HTML error pages such as `Cloudflare 1015 responses`"): parse error bodies defensively and back off exponentially with jitter.
